chunks.text: And AL or AX or whatever is written after that.

chunks.text: So the way that we will be following is we will just take out the two's complement of the number.

chunks.title: Video 19 - Addressing Modes and Instruction set of 8086  part 1
chunks.text: So that's what we mean by this NEG instruction negate.

chunks.title: Video 19 - Addressing Modes and Instruction set of 8086  part 1

chunks.title: Video 19 - Addressing Modes and Instruction set of 8086  part 1

chunks.title: Video 19 - Addressing Modes and Instruction set of 8086  part 1

chunks.title: Video 19 - Addressing Modes and Instruction set of 8086  part 1
chunks.text: You flip every bit and to the result, you add one.

chunks.title: Video 19 - Addressing Modes and Instruction set of 8086  part 1
chunks.text: You will be able to get the two's complement.

chunks.title: Video 19 - Addressing Modes and Instruction set of 8086  part 1
chunks.text: And that's what this negate command will do.

chunks.title: Video 19 - Addressing Modes and Instruction set of 8086  part 1

chunks.title: Video 19 - Addressing Modes and Instruction set of 8086  part 1
chunks.text: So this is a fairly simple command.
